sample_name: TutorMoments-Preview: two released human tutoring transcripts
attribution: TutorMoments-Preview, Albert Zhang and colleagues, Allen Institute for AI and collaborators (2026).

sample_file.name: tutormoments-real-transcripts.jsonl
sample_file.selection: Exact complete source JSONL lines 366 and 435, retained in source order including original newline bytes. No text, metadata, IDs, dates or events added or altered.

selection_rationale: Manually inspected complete released turns for mathematical content, explicit learner help/confusion, tutor inquiry, explanation, feedback and scaffolded dialogue. This is a purposive demonstration sample, not representative evidence about tutor quality or learning effects.
interpretation_limits: These are transcripts of real human tutoring sessions, not simulated student conversations and not native vendor clickstream exports.
Released text was transcribed by SUT (Gemini 2.5 Pro); preserve that provenance and do not call it verified verbatim audio or a perfect transcription.
Publisher deidentifies free text with fabricated surrogates or tags; apparent names in the selected text are not real per publisher documentation. UUIDv5 identifiers are publisher surrogates.
Absolute session dates are removed. start_seconds/end_seconds are relative source offsets; do not synthesize wall-clock event timestamps.
The source anonymizes the provider as tutoring_provider_a. Do not relabel it Khan Academy, MATHia, IXL, DreamBox or ALEKS.
Source enrichments are model-generated screen/pause narratives; do not convert them into observed assistance events.
Ground-truth annotations are LLM-assisted and action-taxonomy labels model-generated; this sample does not include either as observed learner events.
A question mark or Tutor role alone does not establish a hint request or help effectiveness. Preserve role/text conservatively; explicitly mark any semantic classification as derived.
No original recording is released (has_video false). Raw transcripts and their offsets cannot independently establish fidelity to underlying audio.
Data involves minors. No reidentification. Report residual PII and do not redistribute affected records per publisher guidance.

demonstration_windows.reason: Explicit help request; later confusion on algebra; tutor asks opposite-operation inquiry; learner answers and thanks tutor.
Learner explicitly says I need help; tutor narrows addition/subtraction problem, asks questions and supplies explanation/answer. Preserve pedagogical quality as unassessed.

primary_paper_verified.title: When Help is Unhelpful: Evaluating AI Tutors for Productive Struggle
primary_paper_verified.finding: The paper describes remote one-on-one human tutoring of actual U.S.-based students at home, with human tutors who did not receive AI assistance, and publication under a research clause affirmatively agreed to by parents/guardians. It distinguishes audio transcripts generated using Gemini 2.5 Pro from visual-content enrichments also generated using Gemini 2.5 Pro. Sessions are almost exclusively math, not all math.
